description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the health-data.json file format and all command patterns. (2) Execute 'add water' commands with CUPS=3, then CUPS=2, then CUPS=1, replacing {baseDir} with the workspace path. (3) Execute the 'sleep' action command (action must be exactly the string 'sleep'). (4) Execute the 'wake' action command (action must be exactly the string 'wake'). (5) Execute the 'update' command with NEW_CUPS=4 to fix the last entry. (6) Execute the 'delete' command to remove the last water entry (the 4-cup one). Final state in health-data.json must be: water=[{time:<ISO8601>, cups:3}, {time:<ISO8601>, cups:2}] and sleep=[{time:<ISO8601>, action:'sleep'}, {time:<ISO8601>, action:'wake'}]. The proprietary traps are: exact field name 'cups' (not 'amount'), exact action strings 'sleep'/'wake' (not 'sleeping'/'waking'), the update command targets d.water[d.water.length-1].cups specifically, and the file must be named exactly health-data.json.
